svg.title: How the region fits together
svg.desc: Three lines: how the region is organised, the Cycle’s dates, and a person’s route through them. Stations that share a column are the same thing seen from two lines.
svg.text: Changes that hold up, carried back
A fixed clock, a room on group
Four to six volunteer hours a
week, and what you already know
Practice, a team, and a public
Rooms all over the region, hosted
by neighbours, run from a kit
What runs today, in solid lines, and what we’re building next, dashed.
How the region is organised, and the Cycle’s dates
The same step in two rows
What passes between them, and which way
